statements.statement: The service billed was cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271)
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope
The patient has transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has a history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Prolonged cardiac event monitoring is indicated to correlate symptoms with potential rhythm disturbances
The denial reason code is CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits
Prairie State Medicaid is the secondary payer
The primary insurer's Explanation of Benefits is needed for further review
